games.injuries: Temple goes back to Jaxon Smolik at QB for Thursday after Ajani Sheppard struggled (11-for-30, 85 yards vs UAB) and has an ankle injury (K.C. Keeler via Philadelphia Inquirer, Nov 16). Temple TE Peter Clarke (11 TDs) is likely out for the season with a broken fibula (Oct 31). QB switch is a lateral move, so no adjustment. Rice: no notable injury news.
UCF QB Alonza Barnett III is back from a hamstring injury and played all of the Nov 7 win at Kansas. Iowa State: no notable injury news. Rain chance is high at kickoff.

Clemson's freshman starting QB Tait Reynolds is out for the season (knee surgery) and Dabo Swinney confirmed on Nov 17 that QB Christopher Vizzina (concussion) won't play vs Duke; Trent Pearman makes his first career start, with Brock Bradley QB2 and Chris Denson QB3 (The State via Yahoo Sports, Nov 17). The line has held at Duke -13.5 since the news, so most is priced; +1.0 to Duke for the unpriced share. Duke: no notable injury news.
Oregon QB Dante Moore (concussion) is out for the season; Dylan Raiola starts and threw 4 TDs vs Michigan on Nov 14 (KPTV/AP). Michigan State: no current-week injury news.
No current-week injury news found for either team; check the SEC availability report (Wed–Fri).

BYU QB Bear Bachmeier says he feels good physically and accounted for 4 TDs vs Baylor on Nov 14; TE Roger Saleapaga was questionable (Deseret News, Nov 11). Kansas QB Isaiah Marshall played all of the Nov 7 game after a lower-leg issue.

Wake QB Gio Lopez is back from a knee injury and accounted for 3 TDs vs SMU (WBTV/AP, Nov 15). Georgia Tech has used two QBs (Alberto Mendoza, Grady Adamson) and was missing RBs Malachi Hosley and Chad Alexander and safeties Savion Riley, Fenix Felton and Will Kiker (AJC, Nov 13) — known before the line.

Ohio State QB Julian Sayin (throwing arm) is expected to miss the regular season (Ryan Day, Nov 6); Luke Fahey starts and threw 3 TDs vs Northwestern. Long known, so priced. Nebraska: no notable injury news.
Houston QB Conner Weigman threw 3 TDs in the Nov 13 loss at Colorado with no injury reported. West Virginia: no current injury news found.
No notable injury news found for either team.

Big Ten availability reports (Wed–Thu, Nov 18–19; no change reported by Sat morning): Illinois QB Katin Houser (broken nose, surgery Nov 16; concussion per ESPN) is DOUBTFUL and backup QB Michael Clayton II (throwing hand) is OUT, so third-stringer Carson Boyd (0-for-4 passing this season) is expected to start (247Sports; ESPN, Nov 16). The line has held at Illinois +8.5 since Tuesday, when Bielema already called Houser unlikely, so most is priced; -1.5 to Illinois for the unpriced share is kept. Iowa: DB Xavier Styles OUT (Anthony Hawkins starts at strong safety); DBs Zach Lutmer, Jacob Wallace and WR Tony Diaz questionable. Iowa QB Hank Brown starts.
No notable injury news found for either team this week.

UCLA QB Ty Dieffenbach hurt his left shoulder/elbow and ankle vs Illinois but returned and said "It's nothing serious" (ABC7/ESPN, Nov 14). Michigan's freshman Tommy Carr is the starting QB (Kyle Whittingham, Nov 3).
No current-week injury news found; check the SEC availability report (Wed–Fri).
Texas RB Hollywood Smothers is out for the season (torn MCL, reported ~Nov 5) — priced. No QB news for either team.
Washington QB Demond Williams Jr. was expected back as the starter after a rib injury (Jedd Fisch, Nov 3); no update this week. Indiana: no notable injury news.
No notable injury news found for either team.
Miami WR Malachi Toney (high ankle sprain, surgery, Nov 4) is likely still out — priced; Darian Mensah at QB. Virginia Tech: no notable injury news.
Arizona QB Noah Fifita played all of the Nov 14 loss to Utah (356 yards, 3 TDs) (Deseret News). Kansas State: no current injury news.
Pitt QB Mason Heintschel is out for the season (torn ACL, Oct 2); Holden Geriner has started since — priced. Louisville: no current injury news.

South Carolina QB LaNorris Sellers (ankle) is not on Wednesday's SEC availability report and is set to play (ESPN, Nov 18); the line moved from Georgia -16.5 to -14.5, so his return is priced. SEC report (Nov 18): South Carolina out — WR Jayden Sellers, RB Matt Fuller, Edge Kobby Sakyi-Prah, OL Josiah Thompson, OL Dayne Arnett, OL Seth Smith, WR Nitro Tuggle, DB J'Zavien Currence; questionable — WR Nyck Harbor, WR Mazeo Bennett, Edge Dylan Stewart, CB Judge Collier, Edge Anthony Addision. Georgia out — OLB Amaris Williams; questionable — C Drew Bobo (Athens Banner-Herald). Georgia QB Gunner Stockton healthy.
Missouri QB Austin Simmons played the Nov 14 game with no injury reported. Kentucky: no notable injury news.
Notre Dame QB CJ Carr played the Nov 14 win over Boston College with no injuries mentioned (Chicago Sun-Times). SMU: no notable injury news.
Utah QB Devon Dampier played the Nov 14 game (204 pass, 100 rush yards); DT Karson Kaufusi's status is unconfirmed (Deseret News). TCU: no notable injury news.
Boise State QB Maddux Madsen is back from a knee injury (371 yards, 4 TDs vs Oregon State, AP via OPB Nov 15). San Diego State: no notable injury news.
